analysis:
Examined both workflow excerpts and the complete changed-range map. The changes add DARKBLOOM_PROVIDER_TOOLCHAIN=release at .github/workflows/release-provider.yml head:114 and update the older-macOS validation identity requirement from SDK 27.0 (base:1441) to 27.2 (head:1444 in the patch). No supplied change weakens source authorization, signing prerequisites, retained-artifact binding, environment-specific credential selection, or registration-before-alias-publication ordering. Relevant contracts are A-005, A-011, A-017, T-013 and T-054; release publication is not itself independent serving qualification. No inference encryption, prompt exposure, cache isolation, billing or local-helper control changes are visible.
The new workflow-wide selector reaches build, qualification and signing jobs. Integration should verify its interpretation in scripts/prepare-provider-release-toolchain.sh (called at head:430) and .github/actions/provider-release-build (head:215 and 287), including any overrides, so the SDK 27.2 assertion matches the actual release toolchain and retained identity. Those implementations are outside this supplied scope; the comment promising Xcode 27.2 alone is not proof of enforcement. This is an unresolved cross-file contract, not evidence of a regression. The unchanged validation smoke still checks bundle digest, code signature, notarization and older-OS execution (base:1439-1461).
